_label: collapsed: response_format payload-carrying enum replaces summary/fields (file) and mode/impl_only (symbol)
_source: Baseline schemas (cell-a) with the response-shaping parameters removed and replaced by a single response_format property per the mapping table in docs/audit/2026-09-14-response-format-experiment-design.md (aptu-coder #1553). Lookup semantics (match_mode, follow_depth, max_depth, cursor, git_ref) stay top-level. Full preserves tri-state auto-summarize (summary=None >50K) semantics; omitted response_format == Full.

analyze_file.name: analyze_file
analyze_file.description: Functions, types, classes, and imports from a single source file. Fails if directory path supplied; use analyze_directory instead. Paginates with cursor/page_size; use response_format {"fields": [...]} to limit sections. git_ref not supported. Use analyze_module for a lightweight function/import index (~75% smaller). Supported: Astro, C/C++, C#, CSS, Fortran, Go, HTML, Java, JavaScript, JSON, Kotlin, Markdown, Python, Rust, TOML, TSX, TypeScript, YAML.

response_format.description: Response shape (default: full; omit for full). full: complete file analysis; when the rendered output would exceed 50K chars it is auto-summarized to a compact overview unless every section is explicitly required. summary: compact summary only (totals plus section counts, no per-item listings). fields: object payload projecting the output to the listed sections ("functions", "classes", "imports", "all"); the FILE header is always emitted regardless.

cursor.description:
Pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor` field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.
Must be a valid opaque token or omitted entirely; passing an empty string is invalid and is treated as omitted.
Mutually exclusive with response_format=summary; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.

analyze_symbol.name: analyze_symbol
analyze_symbol.description: Call graph for a named symbol across all files in a directory. Prefer over analyze_file when the question is "who calls X" or "what does X call" rather than "what is in this file". Response shapes: full (default call graph), summary, def_use (write/read sites), impl_only (callers from 'impl Trait for Type' blocks only). Fails if file path supplied; fails if response_format=summary and cursor. match_mode controls name matching; git_ref restricts to changed files.

path.description: Directory path to search for the symbol

symbol.description: Symbol name to build call graph for (function or method). Example: `parse_config` finds all callers and callees of that function.

match_mode.description: Symbol matching mode (default: exact). exact: case-sensitive exact match. insensitive: case-insensitive exact match. prefix: case-insensitive prefix match. contains: case-insensitive substring match.

follow_depth.description: Call graph traversal depth for this tool (default 1). Level 1 = direct callers and callees; level 2 = one more hop, etc. Output size grows exponentially with graph branching. Warn user on levels above 2. Hard cap of 3.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory traversal depth. Unset means unlimited. Use 2-3 for large monorepos.

cursor.description:
Pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor` field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.
Must be a valid opaque token or omitted entirely; passing an empty string is invalid and is treated as omitted.
Mutually exclusive with response_format=summary; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.

response_format.description: Analysis mode and response shape (default: full; omit for full). full: build a call graph for the symbol with complete output; when the rendered output would exceed 50K chars it is auto-summarized. summary: compact summary output. def_use: extract write/read sites for the symbol instead of a call graph (symbol must be non-empty). impl_only: restrict callers to only those from 'impl Trait for Type' blocks (Rust only; returns INVALID_PARAMS for non-Rust directories). import_lookup: find all files in the directory that import the module path given in symbol (e.g., std::collections); requires symbol to be non-empty and rejects match_mode/follow_depth/impl_only.

git_ref.description: Restrict analysis to files changed relative to this git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA). Empty string or unset means no filtering.

distractors.name: analyze_directory
distractors.description: Tree-view of directory with LOC, function/class counts, test markers. Respects .gitignore. Paginates with next_cursor. Default max_depth=3. Large dirs (1000+ files) auto-compact to summary; pass summary=false for per-file list. git_ref restricts to files changed since a branch/tag/commit. Empty directories return zero counts.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory traversal depth for overview mode only. Default: 3. Pass 0 for unlimited depth. Use 1-3 for large monorepos to manage output size. Ignored in other modes.

git_ref.description: Restrict analysis to files changed relative to this git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA). Empty string or unset means no filtering.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.

page_size.description: Files per page for pagination (default: 100). Reduce below 100 to limit response size; increase above 100 to reduce round trips.

summary.description: true = compact summary (totals plus directory tree, no per-file function lists); false = full output; unset = auto-summarize when output exceeds 50K chars. Mutually exclusive with cursor; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.
